item.description: Eighteen-year-old Linus Chen-Plotkin from Philadelphia has created a groundbreaking study on the genius of Mozart. This unique characteristic allowed him to both adhere to classical standards and surprise his audience, offering fresh insights into the nature of musical innovation and the essence of artistic excellence.
